narrative.title: The Studio Soundstage Bookings
narrative.scenario: A production studio has one soundstage and a pile of booking requests, each with a start and finish slot. Only one production can shoot at a time, and a new shoot may begin only strictly after the previous one has wrapped. The coordinator packs the calendar by always accepting the request that frees the stage earliest.
narrative.inputFormat: Two integer arrays: start and end times of the meetings.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the maximum number of non-conflicting meetings schedulable in the single room.
constraints: A meeting may start only after the previous chosen meeting ends

testCases.explanation: Selecting (1,2), (3,4), (5,7), (8,9) keeps the stage continuously productive with four shoots.
Every pair collides: (20,30) meets (10,20) exactly at the boundary, which the strict-start rule forbids.

hintLevels: Level 1: Freeing the room earliest leaves the most room for everything else.
Level 2: Sort by end time and greedily take every meeting that starts strictly after the last chosen end.
Level 3: The strict inequality is the boundary rule — start == previous end does NOT fit.
